rapport_notes: Warm, upbeat ("Okay, I love that"), handled a small in-home furniture-relocation job professionally.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "in regards to your items, do you have any questions or concerns besides the estimate" - asked after date/name/email/address/sqft were already collected
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Extensive item-by-item follow-up cataloguing all ~15 heavy/awkward pieces after the customer raised the concern
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: not present - no personalized time anchor or Save Your Ass lines given, call ends without a close

top_strength: Nailed the quid pro quo opener nearly word-for-word from the script ("a few questions... five to ten minutes... accurate quote"), and reframed the "that's way more than I need" minimum-price objection as extra value rather than getting defensive.
coaching_note: Never covered meet-your-mover or the on-time guarantee anywhere in the call, and gave no personalized time-range estimate before quoting the flat minimum — both easy points left on the table on an otherwise strong opening.
